==Description==
The '''First Form''' was an exclusive enemy only available via admin commands during certain 2020 private testing sessions, and has not been in the game in any way since. The only public showcase of this enemy was done in a video made by JOHN ROBLOX<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HENz0rjbAE4</ref>, which also contains footage of features that never made it out of private tests, such as certain UI elements. The enemy itself was made as a joke which was never going to make it into the actual game. It was summoned by the [[Void]] upon entering its second phase. It had a high amount of health and a rather slow speed.

==Appearance==
The '''First Form''' had a grey head and arms. It had a red diamond-plated torso and legs. It also wore a black crown and had multiple grey humanoids coming out of its body.

==Trivia==
*The '''First Form''' is based on the first version of the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Void|Void]].
